description: Dry-run a sequence without sending mail or enrolling anyone. Requires sequences:read and subscribers:read because results include contact samples. Activation does not enroll existing matches unless audienceAutoEnroll is saved. Without a subscriber this reports who currently matches (existing list/tag/segment matches are not auto-enrolled) and activation readiness errors and warnings (for example, an email reading {{webhooks.KEY}} or {{ai.KEY}} that no earlier step saves). Frequency and inactivity current-match counts are unavailable because the hourly worker evaluates them. Pass subscriberId or email to also walk that stored contact's branch path - use this to check whether a specific contact would receive a given step. Call this before enable_sequence.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

email.description: Optional stored subscriber email to walk through the graph. Do not pass with subscriberId.

limit.description: Maximum currently matching contacts to include in the sample. Defaults to 10.

subscriberId.description: Optional stored subscriber to walk through the graph. Do not pass with email.

name: simulate_sequence

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `simulate_sequence` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

enrollment.description: Who currently matches and the confirmation that enable_sequence does not enroll existing contacts. List, tag, and segment matches can still be enrolled by hand.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

path.description: Walked graph for the optional stored subscriber, including branch verdicts, emailStepsOnPath (traversed email nodes), and emailsOnPath (emails deliverable for the subscriber's current email/status). Null when no subscriberId or email was passed.

readiness.description: Activation checks: ready, errors that should be fixed before enable_sequence, and non-blocking warnings.

sendsMail.description: Always false. Simulation never sends mail or enrolls anyone.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
